title: We made World of Warcraft Player Housing IRL
description:
We’re both a little (ahaha no, a LOT) obsessed with the new WoW player housing, so I bugged Scrap to help me make this little World of Warcraft project until he caved. Now we have a sweet Suramar window that we’ll be able to hang in our new house when we move in, which is SOON! We’re feeling a bit Night Elfy when it comes to our taste in decor (Millennial beige, no. Kaldorei Moonberry Amethyst, yes).

We couldn’t have done this project without the two neat tools Creality sent us - the @creality K2 Plus printer, which a lot of these huge pieces fill the whole height of (the build volume is 350x350x350, which makes for nice big clean prints with fewer seams), and the brilliant Falcon A1 Pro, which is a very conveniently sized little diode laser that runs buttery smooth and fast, and we’ve run all sorts of whacky materials through it so far.

A lot of folks have asked us how both tools are, and if you’ve followed our stories you’ll know we’ve used both of them a whole lot since they were sent to us - we wouldn’t promote anything we didn’t 100% stand behind, so our testing has been pretty rigorous. Both the K2 Plus and the Falcon A1 Pro have been massive gamechangers for our little workshop, so we love ‘em, and we recommend ‘em.
